Audience (owner): planners, ADHD-routine and weekly-planning searchers. aplayermode.com serves exactly ONE page (workers/aplayermode-com route()), so every item links to a real section (an id on aplayermode/index.html) of that page; no page is invented. channel.title: A Player Mode
channel.description: A Player Mode is a planning app with a five-role executive team: it builds your plan, has it ready every morning and shrinks bad days, so your brain stops holding everything. Daily and weekly planning help for planners and ADHD-routine seekers.

items.title: Daily Planner App That Plans Your Day for You: Founding 100 at {founding100}/month
items.description: A Player Mode is a planning app with a five-role executive team. Answer easy taps for about 3 minutes and it builds your plan, then has it ready every morning: one priority, a short start, then the day. The first 100 members get Executive Roundtable at {founding100}/month for as long as they stay subscribed. No free trial; cancel any time.

image.headline: Your day, planned for you.
image.body: Answer easy taps for about 3 minutes. Every morning your plan is ready: one priority, a short start, then the day.

items.title: Weekly Planning Without Overplanning: A Working Plan in About 3 Minutes
items.description: Stop designing planners you never use. Tap through easy questions, about 3 minutes to a working plan, no essays. A Player Mode builds your one priority, your minimum day, your rules and your first 7 days, and you approve each piece. Then every morning the plan arrives on its own: one priority, a short start, then the day.

image.headline: Weekly planning without overplanning.
steps: Tap through easy questions: about 3 minutes to a working plan. No essays.
It builds your one priority, your minimum day, your rules and your first 7 days.
Every morning your plan is ready. You never design anything.

items.title: ADHD Morning Routine Help: Max 5 Physical Steps, Then the One Task That Matters
items.description: When starting is the hard part, a plan you have to build yourself is one more task. A Player Mode has your morning order ready at the time you set: feet to the floor, 1 minute of breathing, a glass of water, then your highest-leverage step. Bad days shrink automatically: no catch-up, no guilt. A planning app, not medical advice or treatment.

image.headline: What do I do first this morning?
image.body: Your morning order is ready at the time you set. Max 5 physical steps, then the one task that matters.

items.title: ADHD Routine for Bad Days: A Minimum Day With No Catch-Up and No Guilt
items.description: Routines break the day you miss one. In A Player Mode, Recovery mode gives you a minimum day after a bad day or in a low season: no catch-up, no guilt. Executive Review organizes the 3 to 7 things already in your head without adding new ones, and Deep Work protects one focus block. One tap, no paragraphs about how you feel. A planning app, not medical advice.

image.headline: Bad day? Get a minimum day.
image.body: One tap, any time. A Player Mode changes the day and how it coaches you.
modes: A minimum day. No catch-up, no guilt.
Organizes the 3 to 7 things you already know.
Protects one focus block for one hard task.

items.title: Weekly Planner for Mind, Body and Spirit Goals, Covered Without You Deciding
items.description: Planning work, workouts, sleep, faith and family by hand every week is a job in itself. A Player Mode starts every plan with Mind, Body and Spirit on by default and sorts anything else you care about into one of the three. It picks the workout, protects your sleep and makes room for family and faith, at a safe pace, without you guarding the time.

image.headline: Mind. Body. Spirit. On by default.
modes: Work, money, learning, focus. Your agenda stays on work that moves the needle.
Movement, food, sleep. The workout picked, your sleep protected, at a safe pace.
Faith, gratitude, family. Room made for them, without you guarding the time.
